local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local remotes = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Remotes", 15)
assert(remotes ~= nil, "Remotes folder did not replicate")
assert(remotes:FindFirstChild("RequestInteractBlock") ~= nil, "RequestInteractBlock remote missing")
assert(remotes:FindFirstChild("RequestWorldDirectory") ~= nil, "RequestWorldDirectory remote missing")

local shared = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Shared", 15)
assert(shared ~= nil, "Shared folder did not replicate")
assert(shared:FindFirstChild("Blocks") ~= nil, "Blocks module missing")
assert(shared:FindFirstChild("BlockCategories") ~= nil, "BlockCategories module missing")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer or Players.PlayerAdded:Wait()
assert(player ~= nil, "No player joined during play test")

task.wait(6)
print("BloxLands interaction smoke passed")
